description: A man with dark hair in a long dark coat leans over an open book on a cluttered wooden desk, his hand resting on the page. Potted pea plants with pods line a window sill, and the view outside shows a brick arch and greenery. Magnifying glasses, loose handwritten papers, a sprig of pea plant, bottles and stacked old books fill the room. Warm, dim, painterly light, with no visible frame or border.
